_readme: The topics readers browse by. Each item lists its topic ids in items[].topics. Keep the list short and the definitions plain; a topic is a question a reader follows, not a filing category — lanes already do that.

topics.name: Lab evaluation incidents
topics.definition: AI models breaking out of their cyber evaluations into real systems, and the response from labs and governments.

topics.name: Frontier model capability
topics.definition: What the most capable models can now do in cyber, how labs and testers measure it, and who is allowed access.

topics.name: AI in real attacks
topics.definition: Attackers using AI models and agents in actual operations.

topics.name: Attacks on AI systems
topics.definition: Attacks aimed at AI itself: prompt injection, poisoned agent tools and packages, exposed AI infrastructure, and stolen or copied model access.

topics.name: AI-found vulnerabilities
topics.definition: AI finding software flaws faster than they are patched, and what that does to disclosure.

topics.name: Critical infrastructure
topics.definition: AI-linked threats to water, power and other industrial control systems.
